title_zh: RSV 特异性中和抗体的胎盘组织病理学和经胎盘转移 The Silver 研究
source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Maternally acquired passive immunity via transplacental antibody transport is crucial for the protection of infants against infectious diseases in early life. We examined whether placental histological characteristics impact the transplacental transfer of natural respiratory syncytial virus (RSV)-specific neutralizing antibodies. METHODS: We performed a prospective, observational, cross-sectional study. Pregnant women were enrolled with a 1:1:1 inclusion ratio of extremely preterm-born infants (24-32 weeks), moderately preterm-born infants (33-36 weeks) and term-born infants (37-42 weeks). Cord-maternal ratios (CMRs) for serum neutralizing RSV-A and -B antibodies were analyzed in relation to 16 placental histologic characteristics. RESULTS: In total, 85 mother-infant pairs were available for analysis. Infant gestational age was significantly correlated with CMRs for RSV-A and -B specific antibodies (B = 0.10, P < 0.001). Although a few placental characteristics showed a univariate association with CMR, the multivariate model showed that only gestational age was independently related to CMR (B = 0.11, P < 0.001). CONCLUSIONS: Our study confirms that CMRs increase during gestation. However, variations in placental histology may not affect transplacental RSV-A and RSV-B antibody transfer. We hypothesize that the placental compensatory capacity and active transport mechanism may play a key role in transplacental antibody transfer.
abstract_zh: 背景:母体通过胎盘抗体转运获得的被动免疫对于保护婴儿在生命早期免受传染病至关重要。我们检查了胎盘组织学特征是否影响天然 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 特异性中和抗体的经胎盘转移。方法:我们进行了一项前瞻性、观察性、横断面研究。孕妇按1:1:1的纳入比例纳入极度早产儿(24-32周)、中度早产儿(33-36周)和足月儿(37-42周)。分析血清中和 RSV-A 和 RSV-B 抗体的脐带-母体比率 (CMR) 与 16 个胎盘组织学特征的关系。结果:总共 85 对母婴可供分析。婴儿胎龄与 RSV-A 和 RSV-B 特异性抗体的 CMR 显着相关(B = 0.10,P < 0.001)。尽管一些胎盘特征显示与 CMR 存在单变量关联,但多变量模型显示只有胎龄与 CMR 独立相关(B = 0.11,P < 0.001)。结论:我们的研究证实,CMR 在妊娠期间会增加。然而,胎盘组织学的变化可能不会影响经胎盘的 RSV-A 和 RSV-B 抗体转移。我们假设胎盘代偿能力和主动转运机制可能在胎盘抗体转运中发挥关键作用。

title: Clinical validation of an optimised metagenomic nanopore sequencing method for detecting viral respiratory pathogens.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Clinical metagenomics (CMg) offers high-throughput respiratory pathogen detection with a wider range than targeted, probe-dependent diagnostics. Sequencing cost and the challenges of high host biomass are barriers to the use of CMg in high-throughput respiratory pathogen detection in non-invasive samples such as nasopharyngeal swabs. METHODS: We optimised a nanopore sequencing workflow to detect RNA viruses in nasopharyngeal swabs, employing pathogen enrichment, by background nucleic acid depletion and SISPA amplification, and Oxford Nanopore Technology (ONT) sequencing. As a pre-requisite for agnostic pathogen detection, we first derived quality control (QC) criteria and diagnostic thresholds against a gold-standard comprising 23 pathogen targets detected by routine multiplex PCR. In this diagnostic accuracy study we validated this workflow using 344 prospectively collected upper respiratory tract samples submitted for routine testing. FINDINGS: Using pre-defined QC and positivity criteria, the workflow's sensitivity versus PCR was 51% (95%CI: 45%-57%) (133/260 positive targets detected) (ranging from 19%-85% across pathogens with >20 gold- standard detections), and specificity 99.8% (95%CI: 99.6%-99.9%) (3836/3845 negative targets not detected). Sensitivity improved to 58% (159/274) using post-hoc optimised thresholds, 61% (159/260) only considering RNA pathogens, 70% (144/207) excluding rhinovirus/enterovirus and 83% (140/169) excluding samples with post workflow qPCR Ct values ≥35. Read crossover from multiplex sequencing contributed most (7/9) false-positives. Only 2 plausible additional pathogens were identified (rhinovirus and coronavirus OC43). 41 respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), 13 influenza A and 10 rhinovirus/enterovirus were successfully sub-typed by sequencing. Multiplexed nanopore sequencing costs were £112/sample. INTERPRETATION: Although CMg has substantial diagnostic potential, this validation study demonstrates the technical limitations of current metagenomic sequencing methods applied to viral detection in upper respiratory tract samples with high host and low pathogen biomass. Its greater sensitivity at higher viral loads demonstrates the importance of identifying the most appropriate use cases to maximise its utility and value.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to validate an optimised metagenomic nanopore sequencing method for detecting viral respiratory pathogens, particularly respiratory syncytial virus (RSV). The method involved pathogen enrichment through background nucleic acid depletion and SISPA amplification, using Oxford Nanopore Technology (ONT) sequencing. The workflow was tested against a gold-standard comprising 23 pathogen targets detected by routine multiplex PCR using 344 prospectively collected upper respiratory tract samples. The results showed a sensitivity of 51% (95%CI: 45%-57%) and specificity of 99.8% (95%CI: 99.6%-99.9%) against the gold-standard. Sensitivity improved to 58% (159/274) using post-hoc optimised thresholds, and further to 70% (144/207) and 83% (140/169) when excluding certain pathogens or samples with high host biomass. The study highlights the technical limitations of current metagenomic sequencing methods in detecting viral respiratory pathogens, particularly in samples with high host and low pathogen biomass. The findings suggest that identifying the most appropriate use cases is crucial to maximise the utility of such methods. The study's evidence is moderate due to these limitations.

abstract_zh: 背景:临床宏基因组学 (CMg) 提供高通量呼吸道病原体检测,其范围比靶向、探针依赖性诊断更广泛。测序成本和高 宿主 生物量的挑战是使用 CMg 在鼻咽拭子等非侵入性样本中进行高通量呼吸道病原体检测的障碍。方法:我们优化了纳米孔测序工作流程,通过背景核酸去除和 SISPA 扩增以及牛津纳米孔技术 (ONT) 测序,采用病原体富集来检测鼻咽拭子中的 RNA 病毒。作为未知病原体检测的先决条件,我们首先根据由常规多重 PCR 检测到的 23 个病原体目标组成的黄金标准得出质量控制 (QC) 标准和诊断阈值。在这项诊断准确性研究中,我们使用 344 个前瞻性收集的上呼吸道样本(提交用于常规测试)验证了该工作流程。结果:使用预定义的 QC 和阳性标准,工作流程相对于 PCR 的敏感性为 51% (95%CI: 45%-57%)(检测到 133/260 个阳性目标)(在超过 20 个金标准检测的病原体中,敏感性为 19%-85%),特异性为 99.8%(95%CI:99.6%-99.9%) (未检测到 3836/3845 个阴性目标)。使用事后优化阈值,灵敏度提高至 58% (159/274),仅考虑 RNA 病原体,灵敏度提高至 61% (159/260),排除鼻病毒/肠道病毒,灵敏度提高至 70% (144/207),排除工作流程后 qPCR Ct 值≥35 的样本,灵敏度提高至 83% (140/169)。多重测序的读取交叉造成了大部分 (7/9) 的假阳性。仅鉴定出 2 种可能的其他病原体(鼻病毒和冠状病毒 OC43)。通过测序成功对 41 种 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV)、13 种甲型流感病毒和 10 种鼻病毒/肠道病毒进行了亚型分型。多重纳米孔测序成本为 112 英镑/样本。解释:虽然 CMg 具有巨大的诊断潜力,但这项验证研究表明,当前应用于具有高 宿主 和低病原体生物量的上呼吸道样本病毒检测的宏基因组测序方法存在技术局限性。它对较高病毒载量具有更高的敏感性,这表明确定最合适的用例以最大化其效用和价值的重要性。

title: Updated Evidence for COVID-19, RSV, and Influenza Vaccines for 2025-2026
abstract: 2025 Dec 4;393(22):2221–2242. doi: 10.1056/NEJMsa2514268) In the United States, changes in federal messaging surrounding vaccines have caused disruption to guidance for immunization, though it is known that respiratory illnesses such as respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), influenza, and severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2/COVID-19) can become severe and result in hospitalization, particularly in children under a year of age and in the elderly (65 and older). Recent changes in federal processes have underscored the need for independent evaluation of evidence surrounding these immunizations. This study is a systematic review of recent data surrounding respiratory virus epidemiology, vaccine and immunization efficacy and safety to formulate recommendations for the 2025-2026 respiratory virus season.

Recent changes in federal processes have underscored the need for independent evaluation of evidence surrounding these immunizations. This study is a systematic review of recent data surrounding respiratory virus epidemiology, vaccine and immunization efficacy and safety to formulate recommendations for the 2025-2026 respiratory virus season.

analysis.summary_en: This review synthesizes evidence on human respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), including RSV-A and RSV-B, with a focus on its epidemiology, disease severity, and immunization strategies for the 2025–2026 season. It identifies severe outcomes in young children and older adults as key drivers for targeted vaccination. The review also addresses disruptions in federal immunization guidance, advocating for independent evidence evaluation to guide practice. Gaps remain in harmonizing messaging and ensuring equitable access to RSV vaccines.

title: Priority setting for older adult vaccines in Indonesia: a multi-criteria decision analysis using SMART vaccines.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Indonesia's aging population faces substantial vaccine-preventable disease burdens, while vaccine introduction decisions remain constrained by limited resources and the absence of a prioritization framework. This study prioritized vaccines for older adults in Indonesia using a structured prioritization approach. RESEARCH DESIGN AND METHODS: A multi-criteria decision analysis was conducted using the Strategic Multi-Attribute Ranking Tool for Vaccines. Influenza vaccine (IV), pneumococcal conjugate vaccine (PCV), recombinant zoster vaccine (RZV), and respiratory syncytial virus vaccine (RSVV) were assessed across 10 attributes. Stakeholders confirmed vaccine candidates, validated criteria, assigned weights, and scored vaccines. One-way sensitivity analyses and an exploratory proxy uncertainty analysis were performed to assess ranking robustness. RESULTS: Seventeen representatives from ten stakeholder institutions participated. The highest weighted attributes were quality-adjusted life years gained/disability-adjusted life years averted (14.44%), relevance to older adult public health priorities (12.78%), premature deaths averted (11.89%), net budget impact (11.44%), and cost-effectiveness (11.22%). Composite scores ranked IV first (858.25), followed by PCV (809.24), RSVV (569.39), and RZV (558.03). Rankings remained unchanged across all sensitivity and proxy uncertainty analyses. CONCLUSIONS: IV was the highest-priority vaccine for older adults in Indonesia, followed by PCV, RSVV, and RZV. This framework provides an evidence-informed basis for vaccine policy and healthy aging strategies.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Indonesia faces substantial vaccine-preventable disease burdens among older adults alongside constrained resources for vaccine introduction, creating a need for a structured prioritization framework to guide vaccine policy decisions.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This study used a multi-criteria decision analysis with the Strategic Multi-Attribute Ranking Tool for Vaccines to prioritize vaccines for older adults in Indonesia, involving 17 representatives from ten stakeholder institutions.
analysis.methods: The analysis assessed four vaccines—influenza vaccine, pneumococcal conjugate vaccine, recombinant zoster vaccine, and respiratory syncytial virus vaccine—across 10 attributes, with stakeholders assigning weights and scoring vaccines.

analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The framework identified influenza vaccine as the highest-priority vaccine for older adults in Indonesia, providing an evidence-informed basis for policy decisions and healthy aging strategies.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The prioritization framework can inform evidence-based vaccine policy and resource allocation for older adult immunization programs in Indonesia.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study’s reliance on stakeholder input and abstract-level evidence limits generalizability, and the absence of clinical or epidemiological data reduces the strength of conclusions to moderate.

analysis.summary_en: This study prioritized vaccines for older adults in Indonesia using a multi-criteria decision analysis with the Strategic Multi-Attribute Ranking Tool for Vaccines. Four vaccines—influenza, pneumococcal conjugate, recombinant zoster, and respiratory syncytial virus vaccines—were evaluated across 10 attributes by 17 stakeholders from ten institutions. Influenza vaccine ranked highest (858.25), followed by pneumococcal conjugate (809.24), RSV (569.39), and zoster (558.03) vaccines. Rankings were robust across sensitivity analyses. The framework provides an evidence-informed basis for vaccine policy and healthy aging strategies in Indonesia.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 印度尼西亚在老年人中面临着巨大的 疫苗 可预防疾病负担,同时引入 疫苗 的资源也有限,因此需要一个结构化的优先顺序框架来指导 疫苗 政策决策。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究使用多标准决策分析和 疫苗 战略多属性排名工具来优先考虑印度尼西亚老年人的 疫苗,涉及来自 10 个利益相关机构的 17 名代表。
elements_zh.methods: 该分析评估了四种 疫苗(流感 疫苗、肺炎球菌结合物 疫苗、重组带状疱疹 疫苗 和 呼吸道合胞病毒 疫苗)的 10 个属性,由利益相关者分配权重并对 疫苗 进行评分。
elements_zh.main_results: 综合评分中,流感 疫苗 排名第一 (858.25),其次是肺炎球菌结合物 疫苗 (809.24)、呼吸道合胞病毒 疫苗 (569.39) 和重组带状疱疹 疫苗 (558.03)。所有敏感性和代理不确定性分析的排名均保持不变。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该框架将流感 疫苗 确定为印度尼西亚老年人的最高优先级 疫苗,为政策决策和健康老龄化战略提供了循证基础。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 优先顺序框架可以为印度尼西亚老年人免疫规划的基于证据的 疫苗 政策和资源分配提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究对利益相关者的意见和抽象证据的依赖限制了普遍性,并且缺乏临床或流行病学数据使结论的强度降低到中等。

analysis_en.methods: The analysis assessed four vaccines—influenza vaccine, pneumococcal conjugate vaccine, recombinant zoster vaccine, and respiratory syncytial virus vaccine—across 10 attributes, with stakeholders assigning weights and scoring vaccines.
analysis_en.main_results: Composite scores ranked influenza vaccine first (858.25), followed by pneumococcal conjugate vaccine (809.24), respiratory syncytial virus vaccine (569.39), and recombinant zoster vaccine (558.03). Rankings remained unchanged across all sensitivity and proxy uncertainty analyses.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The framework identified influenza vaccine as the highest-priority vaccine for older adults in Indonesia, providing an evidence-informed basis for policy decisions and healthy aging strategies.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The prioritization framework can inform evidence-based vaccine policy and resource allocation for older adult immunization programs in Indonesia.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study’s reliance on stakeholder input and abstract-level evidence limits generalizability, and the absence of clinical or epidemiological data reduces the strength of conclusions to moderate.

title_zh: 印度尼西亚老年人 疫苗 的优先级设置:使用 SMART 疫苗 的多标准决策分析。
source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Indonesia's aging population faces substantial vaccine-preventable disease burdens, while vaccine introduction decisions remain constrained by limited resources and the absence of a prioritization framework. This study prioritized vaccines for older adults in Indonesia using a structured prioritization approach. RESEARCH DESIGN AND METHODS: A multi-criteria decision analysis was conducted using the Strategic Multi-Attribute Ranking Tool for Vaccines. Influenza vaccine (IV), pneumococcal conjugate vaccine (PCV), recombinant zoster vaccine (RZV), and respiratory syncytial virus vaccine (RSVV) were assessed across 10 attributes. Stakeholders confirmed vaccine candidates, validated criteria, assigned weights, and scored vaccines. One-way sensitivity analyses and an exploratory proxy uncertainty analysis were performed to assess ranking robustness. RESULTS: Seventeen representatives from ten stakeholder institutions participated. The highest weighted attributes were quality-adjusted life years gained/disability-adjusted life years averted (14.44%), relevance to older adult public health priorities (12.78%), premature deaths averted (11.89%), net budget impact (11.44%), and cost-effectiveness (11.22%). Composite scores ranked IV first (858.25), followed by PCV (809.24), RSVV (569.39), and RZV (558.03). Rankings remained unchanged across all sensitivity and proxy uncertainty analyses. CONCLUSIONS: IV was the highest-priority vaccine for older adults in Indonesia, followed by PCV, RSVV, and RZV. This framework provides an evidence-informed basis for vaccine policy and healthy aging strategies.
abstract_zh: 背景:印度尼西亚的老龄化人口面临着巨大的 疫苗 可预防疾病负担,而 疫苗 的引入决策仍然受到资源有限和缺乏优先框架的限制。本研究采用结构化优先顺序方法,为印度尼西亚老年人确定了 疫苗 的优先顺序。研究设计和方法:使用 疫苗 的战略多属性排名工具进行多标准决策分析。对流感 疫苗 (IV)、肺炎球菌结合物 疫苗 (PCV)、重组带状疱疹 疫苗 (RZV) 和 呼吸道合胞病毒 疫苗 (RSVV) 的 10 个属性进行了评估。利益相关者确认了 疫苗 候选者、验证了标准、分配了权重并对 疫苗 进行了评分。进行单向敏感性分析和探索性代理不确定性分析来评估排名的稳健性。结果:来自 10 个利益相关机构的 17 名代表参加了会议。权重最高的属性是质量调整生命年增加/残疾调整生命年避免(14.44%)、与老年人公共卫生优先事项的相关性(12.78%)、避免过早死亡(11.89%)、净预算影响(11.44%)和成本效益(11.22%)。综合得分排名IV第一(858.25),其次是PCV(809.24)、RSVV(569.39)和RZV(558.03)。所有敏感性和代理不确定性分析的排名均保持不变。结论:IV 是印度尼西亚老年人最优先考虑的 疫苗,其次是 PCV、RSVV 和 RZV。该框架为 疫苗 政策和健康老龄化战略提供了循证基础。

title: Distinguishing common respiratory pathogens using machine learning of symptom profiles to prioritize diagnostic testing.
abstract: Clinical symptoms are critical for diagnosing and managing upper respiratory tract infections, yet systematic comparisons across common pathogens remain limited. We aimed to characterize symptom signatures across common respiratory pathogens and to develop approaches that support the prioritization of diagnostic testing across pathogens. Using a large-scale, home-based multiplex PCR testing dataset, we characterized symptom profiles across common respiratory pathogens stratified by age and sex. Hierarchical clustering was applied to group pathogens into symptom-based categories, and a multilayer perceptron (MLP) model was trained to predict these cluster-level categories. A post-hoc refinement combined MLP outputs with contemporaneous epidemiological data to further prioritize likely pathogens within predicted categories. Model performance was evaluated using the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC), classification accuracy, and related metrics. Symptom profiles overlapped substantially across pathogens, with differences being more categorical than pathogen-specific: RSV, HCoV, HPIV, and HRV were predominantly characterized by respiratory symptoms, whereas influenza A/B and SARS-CoV-2 showed more pronounced systemic manifestations. The MLP model achieved high AUCs (0.80-0.92, depending on age group) with specificities exceeding 75% but lower sensitivities, reflecting a conservative prediction pattern. Integrating cluster-level predictions with contemporaneous epidemiology improved the prioritization of prevalent pathogens, though performance remained limited for less common ones. When expanding predictions to the top three likely pathogens, the model enabled diagnostic test prioritization with an overall accuracy of 0.83 (95% CI, 0.82-0.84). Our study supports the use of readily available symptom data to inform the prioritization of diagnostic testing, particularly during outbreaks or in resource-limited settings where timely laboratory testing is constrained. In addition, the systematic symptom signatures identified across common respiratory pathogens may inform the development and optimization of symptom-based patient-reported outcomes for future antiviral trials.

title_zh: 使用症状特征的机器学习来区分常见的呼吸道病原体,以优先考虑诊断测试。
source_body_en: Clinical symptoms are critical for diagnosing and managing upper respiratory tract infections, yet systematic comparisons across common pathogens remain limited. We aimed to characterize symptom signatures across common respiratory pathogens and to develop approaches that support the prioritization of diagnostic testing across pathogens. Using a large-scale, home-based multiplex PCR testing dataset, we characterized symptom profiles across common respiratory pathogens stratified by age and sex. Hierarchical clustering was applied to group pathogens into symptom-based categories, and a multilayer perceptron (MLP) model was trained to predict these cluster-level categories. A post-hoc refinement combined MLP outputs with contemporaneous epidemiological data to further prioritize likely pathogens within predicted categories. Model performance was evaluated using the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC), classification accuracy, and related metrics. Symptom profiles overlapped substantially across pathogens, with differences being more categorical than pathogen-specific: RSV, HCoV, HPIV, and HRV were predominantly characterized by respiratory symptoms, whereas influenza A/B and SARS-CoV-2 showed more pronounced systemic manifestations. The MLP model achieved high AUCs (0.80-0.92, depending on age group) with specificities exceeding 75% but lower sensitivities, reflecting a conservative prediction pattern. Integrating cluster-level predictions with contemporaneous epidemiology improved the prioritization of prevalent pathogens, though performance remained limited for less common ones. When expanding predictions to the top three likely pathogens, the model enabled diagnostic test prioritization with an overall accuracy of 0.83 (95% CI, 0.82-0.84). Our study supports the use of readily available symptom data to inform the prioritization of diagnostic testing, particularly during outbreaks or in resource-limited settings where timely laboratory testing is constrained. In addition, the systematic symptom signatures identified across common respiratory pathogens may inform the development and optimization of symptom-based patient-reported outcomes for future antiviral trials.

title: LNP-CpG: deploy the self-adjuvant role of mRNA vaccines
abstract: With the rapid advancement of mRNA vaccines, lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) have emerged as pivotal carriers and adjuvants for non-mRNA vaccine modalities, driven by their superior nucleic acid delivery efficiency and intrinsic self-adjuvanting properties. In this study, we systematically evaluated various formulation strategies combining LNPs and the CpG adjuvant within a varicella-zoster virus glycoprotein E (VZV-gE) subunit vaccine framework. We demonstrated that uniform nanoparticles formed by LNP-encapsulated CpG (LNP-CpG), when simply admixed with the gE antigen, elicited superior immunogenicity compared to alternative encapsulation configurations. Intramuscular administration of a two-dose (LNP-CpG)+gE regimen significantly augmented both humoral and cellular immune responses in mice, markedly outperforming the commercial vaccine Shingrix (administered at a 1/10 human dose). Crucially, the identical regimen induced robust, comparable immune profiles to a full human dose of Shingrix in rhesus macaques. Furthermore, LNP-CpG displayed broad-spectrum utility across diverse vaccine platforms, demonstrating efficacy against both respiratory (RSV) and neurotropic (HSV) pathogens, compatibility with multiple modalities, including subunit (VZV-gE, RSV-Pre-F), live-attenuated (LA-HSV), and inactivated (i-HSV) vaccines; and versatile implementation in a combined VZV+RSV formulation. Collectively, our findings position LNP-CpG as a versatile, safe, highly efficacious adjuvant platform with substantial clinical translational potential, offering a compelling paradigm for next-generation vaccine development.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addresses the need to enhance immunogenicity of subunit vaccines by leveraging lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) as carriers and adjuvants, building on their nucleic acid delivery efficiency and intrinsic self-adjuvanting properties.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The research systematically evaluated LNP-CpG formulations combined with varicella-zoster virus glycoprotein E (VZV-gE) in a subunit vaccine framework, assessing immunogenicity in mice and rhesus macaques.
analysis.methods: The authors compared LNP-encapsulated CpG (LNP-CpG) admixed with gE antigen against alternative encapsulation configurations and benchmarked responses against the commercial vaccine Shingrix.

analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret LNP-CpG as a versatile adjuvant platform with broad-spectrum utility across multiple vaccine modalities and pathogens, highlighting its translational potential for next-generation vaccine development.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest LNP-CpG could improve vaccine efficacy and flexibility, offering a promising approach for enhancing protection against diverse pathogens including respiratory viruses.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is limited to preclinical models (mice and macaques) and does not report human clinical trial data, which constrains direct translational claims and generalizability to human populations.

analysis.summary_en: This preprint evaluates LNP-CpG as a self-adjuvanting platform for subunit vaccines, focusing on varicella-zoster virus glycoprotein E (VZV-gE). The study demonstrates that LNP-encapsulated CpG (LNP-CpG) admixed with gE antigen elicits superior immunogenicity in mice compared to alternative formulations and outperforms a 1/10 human dose of the commercial vaccine Shingrix. In rhesus macaques, the same regimen induces immune responses comparable to a full human dose of Shingrix. The authors further show that LNP-CpG is effective across multiple vaccine modalities and pathogens, including respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) and herpes simplex virus (HSV), and can be implemented in combined formulations. While the results are promising, the study is limited to preclinical models and lacks human clinical data, which restricts the strength of translational claims.

title: Development of an Agnostic Clinical Metagenomic Workflow for Respiratory RNA Viruses
abstract: Abstract Background Clinical metagenomics has the potential to provide an agnostic approach to respiratory virus diagnostics, but there are substantial methodological challenges. Viral loads vary by orders of magnitude among respiratory samples and nucleic acid extracts are dominated by non-target sequences, particularly for samples from the upper respiratory tract. This necessitates upstream virus enrichment and non-specific amplification approaches adaptable to high-throughput assays. We aimed to develop such a workflow for respiratory RNA viruses. Methods We used nasopharyngeal swabs in viral transport medium remaining after routine microbiological testing of clinical samples at Oxford University Hospital NHS Foundation Trust (UK) was completed. Pre-extraction virus enrichment and non-target nucleic acid depletion methods evaluated included differential centrifugation, bead-beating, nuclease treatment and virus precipitation. RNA was extracted, then reverse transcribed using random N 9 priming to include the oligonucleotide (5’-GATGATAGTAGGGCTTCGTCAC-N 9 -3’) used in subsequent amplification. Two amplification approaches were designed and compared side-by-side: isothermal multiple displacement amplification via Equiphi29 DNA polymerase using circularised template versus PCR-based sequence independent single primer amplification. Sequencing used the Oxford Nanopore Technologies platform. Results Our final optimised workflow combined multiple approaches to virus enrichment; sample clarification (3,200g centrifugation, 30 minutes), nuclease treatment, virus precipitation and centrifugation (13,200g, 30 minutes). RNA was extracted from the resultant pellet. Sequence independent single primer amplification was adopted in the final workflow as it consistently out-performed multiple displacement amplification. During development work, we detected a wide range of respiratory viruses, including coronaviruses (SARS-Cov-2, OC43, NC63, 229E), influenza A and B, respiratory syncytial virus, parainfluenza 2, 3 and 4, human metapneumovirus, human rhino- and enteroviruses, together with an extraction control (MS2) and controls for reverse transcription and amplification controls (Zika, murine respirovirus and orthoreovirus RNA). Conclusions We have developed an agnostic clinical metagenomics workflow for RNA respiratory viruses, with potential for use in molecular diagnostics. Subsequent work will determine sensitivity and specificity relative to performance current standard-of-care diagnostics such as commercial respiratory PCR panels.

analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted their findings as demonstrating a robust agnostic workflow for respiratory RNA viruses, which could enhance molecular diagnostics. This approach is novel in its integration of multiple enrichment methods.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings have implications for improving the detection of respiratory viruses in clinical settings, potentially enhancing diagnostic accuracy and informing public health surveillance strategies.

title: TREATMENT AND CLINICAL MANAGEMENT PROTOCOLS FOR ACUTE VIRAL BRONCHIOLITIS IN INFANTS
abstract: Objective: To critically review recent scientific evidence regarding treatment protocols and clinical management of acute viral bronchiolitis in infants, emphasizing supportive interventions, pharmacological therapies, respiratory support, and strategies for preventing respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) infection. Methods: A narrative literature review was conducted using PubMed, employing keywords related to viral bronchiolitis and therapeutic interventions. Priority was given to recent studies addressing the clinical and therapeutic management of acute viral bronchiolitis in infants, including systematic reviews, clinical trials, and evidence-based guidelines. Results: The analyzed evidence reinforces that the management of acute viral bronchiolitis remains predominantly based on supportive measures, ensuring adequate oxygenation, hydration, and nutrition. Low-flow oxygen therapy is the initial approach for patients with hypoxemia, whereas high-flow nasal cannula therapy may reduce the need for escalation of care when conventional support is insufficient. Bronchodilators, epinephrine, corticosteroids, and antibiotics do not show consistent clinical benefit to justify their routine use. Nebulized hypertonic saline may provide a modest reduction in the length of hospital stay, but the low certainty of the evidence limits its systematic recommendation. Regarding the prevention of RSV-associated disease, palivizumab remains an option for selected infants at higher risk of severe disease, while nirsevimab and maternal immunization expand the available prevention strategies. Conclusion: Contemporary management of acute viral bronchiolitis should prioritize supportive measures and the judicious, stepped use of respiratory support, avoiding pharmacological interventions that lack proven clinical benefit. Despite recent advances, gaps remain regarding the selection and escalation of respiratory support modalities. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在严格审查有关 治疗 方案和婴儿急性病毒 毛细支气管炎 临床管理的最新科学证据,强调支持性干预、药物治疗、呼吸支持和预防 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 感染的策略。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 使用 PubMed 进行叙述性文献综述,重点关注近期针对婴儿急性病毒 毛细支气管炎 的临床和治疗管理的研究,包括系统评价、临床试验和循证指南。
elements_zh.methods: 优先考虑最近针对婴儿急性病毒 毛细支气管炎 的临床和治疗管理的研究,包括系统评价、临床试验和循证指南。
elements_zh.main_results: 分析的证据强调,急性病毒 毛细支气管炎 的治疗仍然主要基于支持性措施,确保足够的氧合、水合和营养。低流量氧疗是低氧血症患者的首选治疗方法,而高流量鼻插管治疗可能会在常规支持不足时减少护理升级的需要。支气管扩张剂、肾上腺素、皮质类固醇和抗生素并未显示出一致的临床益处来证明其常规使用的合理性。雾化高渗盐水可能会适度缩短住院时间,但证据质量低限制了其系统推荐。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,当代急性病毒 毛细支气管炎 的治疗应优先考虑支持性措施和明智、逐步使用呼吸支持,避免缺乏经过证实的临床益处的药物干预。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果谨慎地表明,在管理急性病毒 毛细支气管炎 时需要优先考虑支持性护理和逐步使用呼吸支持,同时还强调了使用新的预防策略(如帕利珠单抗、尼塞韦单抗 和孕产妇免疫)更新临床方案的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于某些研究结果的确定性较低,尤其是雾化高渗盐水,证据受到限制,并且在呼吸支持方式的选择和升级方面仍然存在差距。

title: SIRT1 Activator Resveratrol Attenuates Age-Related Skin Thinning in Mice.
abstract: Aging is associated with thinning of the epidermis and dermis, leading to wrinkles, dryness, and impaired skin barrier function. Sirtuin-1 (SIRT1) is an NAD+-dependent protein deacetylase that suppresses cellular senescence and matrix metalloproteinase (MMP) expression, both of which contribute to skin thinning. Here, we investigated whether dietary resveratrol (RSV), a SIRT1 activator, mitigates age-related skin thinning in mice. Epidermal and dermal thicknesses were significantly reduced in 60-week-old (wo) mice compared with 20-wo mice, and these changes were attenuated by RSV administration (0.4 g/kg diet) from 28 weeks of age for 32 weeks. In the epidermis, the number of Ki67-positive cells decreased in aged mice but was restored by RSV treatment. Although RSV did not alter the number of SIRT1-positive cells, it significantly reduced the number of acetyl-lysine-positive cells, indicating enhanced SIRT1 activity. In the dermis, the immunopositive areas of MMP-9 and MMP-13 increased in aged mice, and these age-associated increases were not observed in RSV-treated aged mice. Phosphorylated SMAD2 levels decreased with age but were not affected by RSV. Furthermore, SIRT1 knockdown in human HaCaT keratinocytes increased p21 expression and senescence-associated β-galactosidase activity. Taken together, these findings suggest that the SIRT1 activator RSV ameliorates age-related skin thinning by suppressing cellular senescence in the epidermis and inhibiting dermal collagen degradation.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated whether dietary resveratrol (RSV), a SIRT1 activator, mitigates age-related skin thinning in mice. Aging was associated with reduced epidermal and dermal thickness, increased MMP-9 and MMP-13 expression, and decreased Ki67-positive cells. RSV administration from 28 weeks of age for 32 weeks attenuated these age-related changes, restoring Ki67-positive cell counts and reducing acetyl-lysine-positive cells, indicating enhanced SIRT1 activity. In the dermis, RSV prevented the age-associated increase in MMP-9 and MMP-13 immunopositive areas. Phosphorylated SMAD2 levels decreased with age but were unaffected by RSV. These results suggest that RSV may ameliorate skin thinning by suppressing cellular senescence and inhibiting collagen degradation. The study is limited to mice and relies on biochemical and histological analyses, which may not fully translate to human conditions. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the lack of direct human data and the potential for confounding factors.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 衰老与表皮和真皮变薄有关,导致皱纹、干燥和皮肤屏障功能受损。该研究旨在调查膳食白藜芦醇(RSV)(一种 SIRT1 激活剂)是否可以减轻小鼠与年龄相关的皮肤变薄。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究以小鼠为对象,测量了 20 只和 60 只小鼠的表皮和真皮厚度。从 28 周龄开始,对 60 只小鼠进行了为期 32 周的 RSV 给药测试。
elements_zh.methods: 使用组织学分析测量表皮和真皮厚度。通过免疫组织化学评估 Ki67 阳性细胞和乙酰赖氨酸阳性细胞的数量。使用蛋白质印迹评估磷酸化 SMAD2 水平。使用 siRNA 敲低人 HaCaT 角质形成细胞中的 SIRT1,并测量 p21 表达和衰老相关的 β-半乳糖苷酶活性。
elements_zh.main_results: 与 20 周龄小鼠相比,60 周龄小鼠的表皮和真皮厚度显着减少,并且这些变化通过 RSV 给药而减弱。在老年小鼠的表皮中,Ki67 阳性细胞的数量减少,但 RSV 治疗 使 Ki67 阳性细胞的数量恢复。RSV 显着减少了乙酰赖氨酸阳性细胞的数量,表明 SIRT1 活性增强。在真皮中,老年小鼠的 MMP-9 和 MMP-13 免疫阳性区域有所增加,但在 RSV 治疗的老年小鼠中并未观察到这些与年龄相关的增加。磷酸化 SMAD2 水平随着年龄的增长而降低,但不受 RSV 的影响。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现表明,SIRT1 激活剂 RSV 通过抑制表皮细胞衰老和抑制真皮胶原蛋白降解来改善与年龄相关的皮肤变薄。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能为未来研究 SIRT1 在与年龄相关的皮肤变化中的作用以及 SIRT1 激活剂在皮肤衰老治疗干预中的潜在用途提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于小鼠,并未考虑人类的变异性。证据基于组织学和生化分析,结果被解释为暗示一种机制,而不是建立因果关系。研究结果的可信度为中等。

title: Improving Maternal Vaccination: Analysis of Formative Interviews with Prenatal Health Care Providers.
abstract: OBJECTIVE: Maternal vaccination rates are low in the United States. Understanding barriers to vaccination for pregnant women from the provider's perspective can help better address these issues. This exploratory study assesses participating prenatal health care providers' beliefs and perspectives regarding maternal vaccination for Tdap, flu, COVID-19, and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) vaccines. METHODS: This qualitative study included 24 virtual in-depth interviews with prenatal health care providers (12 physicians, 12 certified nurse midwives) working in rural and urban areas. Thematic analysis was conducted to identify perceived barriers and challenges to prenatal care, provider perceptions and recommendations on Tdap, flu, COVID-19, and RSV vaccines, vaccination resources shared with pregnant women, and vaccine administration practices. RESULTS: Most providers reported pregnant women were receptive to vaccination when benefits and risks of prenatal vaccination were explained. Rural providers identified barriers to care that included limited transportation, lack of access to health care, and language barriers. Findings also indicate prenatal health care providers can foster trust, engage in two-way conversations, and navigate patients' cultural influences when addressing vaccination challenges. CONCLUSION: Provider communication about maternal vaccination should be grounded in an evidence-based, participatory approach. Building trust, recognizing and addressing cultural barriers and access challenges are key to identifying practical steps to support access to and uptake of maternal vaccinations.

abstract_zh: 目标:美国孕产妇 疫苗接种 率较低。从提供者的角度了解 疫苗接种 对孕妇的障碍有助于更好地解决这些问题。这项探索性研究评估了参与的产前保健提供者对孕产妇 疫苗接种 治疗 Tdap、流感、COVID-19 和 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 疫苗 的信念和观点。方法:这项定性研究包括对在农村和城市地区工作的产前保健提供者(12 名医生、12 名经过认证的护士助产士)进行的 24 次虚拟深度访谈。进行了主题分析,以确定产前护理的感知障碍和挑战、提供者对 Tdap、流感、COVID-19 和 RSV 疫苗 的看法和建议、与孕妇共享的 疫苗 资源以及 疫苗 管理实践。结果:大多数提供者报告,当解释了产前 疫苗接种 的益处和风险时,孕妇能够接受 疫苗接种。农村提供者发现了护理障碍,包括交通有限、缺乏医疗保健和语言障碍。研究结果还表明,产前医疗保健提供者在应对 疫苗接种 挑战时可以建立信任、进行双向对话并驾驭患者的文化影响。结论:提供者关于孕产妇 疫苗接种 的沟通应以循证、参与式方法为基础。建立信任、认识并解决文化障碍和获取挑战是确定支持获取和采用孕产妇 疫苗接种 的实际步骤的关键。

title: Association Between Respiratory Vaccines and Risk of Cognitive Impairment, Dementia and Alzheimer’s Disease: A Scoping Review
abstract: Background/Objectives: Neurocognitive disorders represent a growing burden among older adults. Although respiratory vaccines have demonstrated efficacy and safety in preventing acute respiratory events, their potential impact on the development of chronic neurocognitive disorders, such as cognitive impairment, dementia, and Alzheimer’s disease (AD), has not been extensively explored. The objective of this scoping review was to synthesize and analyze the available evidence on the association between respiratory vaccination and the risk of developing cognitive impairment, dementia, and Alzheimer’s disease. Methods: A scoping review was conducted in accordance with the PRISMA-ScR guidelines. A literature search was performed in the PubMed, Scopus, and Web of Science databases through 15 June 2026. Studies involving older adults (≥60 years), irrespective of their baseline neurocognitive status, were included. Observational studies (cohort and case–control studies) were considered. Editorials, narrative reviews, and other non-original articles were excluded. Results: Eighteen studies were included, with cohort studies being the predominant design. Four main categories of respiratory vaccines were evaluated: influenza, COVID-19, respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), and pneumococcal vaccines, in relation to the risk of cognitive impairment, dementia, and AD. Influenza vaccination was associated with a lower risk of dementia and AD, with a potential dose–response relationship observed, whereby a greater number of vaccinations was associated with a greater reduction in risk. Pneumococcal vaccination was also associated with a lower risk of dementia and AD, particularly among individuals who received a greater number of vaccine doses. In contrast, the evidence regarding COVID-19 and RSV vaccines was limited and yielded heterogeneous findings. Conclusions: Influenza and pneumococcal vaccination maybe associated with a lower risk of Alzheimer’s disease and dementia. However, the evidence regarding COVID-19 and RSV vaccines remains limited, and additional studies are needed to clarify their impact on the risk of developing neurocognitive disorders.

analysis.scope_and_question: The scoping review aimed to examine the association between respiratory vaccination and the risk of cognitive impairment, dementia, and Alzheimer’s disease, focusing on human respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) and its variants. The review included observational studies on older adults (≥60 years) regardless of their baseline neurocognitive status.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: A scoping review was conducted following PRISMA-ScR guidelines, with a literature search in PubMed, Scopus, and Web of Science databases up to 15 June 2026. Non-original articles such as editorials and narrative reviews were excluded. The review included cohort and case–control studies.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Influenza and pneumococcal vaccination were associated with a lower risk of dementia and Alzheimer’s disease, with a potential dose–response relationship observed for influenza. The evidence for RSV and COVID-19 vaccines was limited and heterogeneous, with no consistent conclusions drawn.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The evidence regarding RSV and COVID-19 vaccines was limited and yielded heterogeneous findings. There is a lack of clarity on the impact of these vaccines on neurocognitive disorders, necessitating further research. The review also noted that the evidence for RSV vaccines was not robust enough to draw definitive conclusions.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Additional studies are needed to clarify the impact of RSV and COVID-19 vaccines on the risk of developing neurocognitive disorders. Research should focus on longitudinal studies and diverse populations to better understand the potential associations.

analysis.summary_en: This scoping review explores the association between respiratory vaccination and the risk of cognitive impairment, dementia, and Alzheimer’s disease, with a focus on respiratory syncytial virus (RSV). The review included 18 observational studies, primarily cohort studies, on older adults. Influenza and pneumococcal vaccines were linked to a reduced risk of dementia and Alzheimer’s disease, with a potential dose–response relationship for influenza. However, the evidence for RSV and COVID-19 vaccines was limited and inconsistent, highlighting the need for further research to clarify their impact on neurocognitive disorders. The review underscores the importance of targeted studies to better understand the long-term effects of these vaccines on cognitive health.

abstract_zh: 背景/目标:神经认知障碍是老年人日益沉重的负担。尽管呼吸疫苗已被证明在预防急性呼吸系统事件方面有效且安全,但其对认知障碍、痴呆和阿尔茨海默病(AD)等慢性神经认知障碍的潜在影响尚未得到广泛探讨。本次范围审查的目的是综合和分析呼吸 疫苗接种 与发生认知障碍、痴呆和阿尔茨海默病风险之间关联的现有证据。方法:根据 PRISMA-ScR 指南进行范围界定审查。截至 2026 年 6 月 15 日,我们在 PubMed、Scopus 和 Web of Science 数据库中进行了文献检索。纳入了涉及老年人(≥60 岁)的研究,无论其基线神经认知状态如何。考虑了观察性研究(队列研究 和病例对照研究)。社论、叙述性评论和其他非原创文章被排除在外。结果:纳入了 18 项研究,其中 队列研究 研究是主要设计。评估了呼吸道 疫苗 的四个主要类别:流感、COVID-19、呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 和肺炎球菌 疫苗 与认知障碍、痴呆和 AD 风险的关系。流感 疫苗接种 与较低的痴呆症和 AD 风险相关,并观察到潜在的剂量反应关系,即 疫苗接种 数量越大,风险降低幅度越大。肺炎球菌 疫苗 还与较低的痴呆症和 AD 风险相关,特别是在接受较多 疫苗 剂量的个体中。相比之下,有关 COVID-19 和 RSV 疫苗 的证据有限,并且得出了异质的发现。结论:流感和肺炎球菌 疫苗接种 可能与阿尔茨海默病和痴呆症的风险降低有关。然而,有关 COVID-19 和 RSV 疫苗 的证据仍然有限,需要进行更多研究来阐明它们对发生神经认知障碍风险的影响。

title: Molecular epidemiology of respiratory viral infections in hospitalized children in Novosibirsk, Russia, 2021–2023
abstract: Background Acute respiratory infections (ARIs) are among the leading global causes of morbidity and mortality in children. While viral agents of ARI are rigorously monitored, other pathogenic organisms and pathobionts — bacteria and fungi native to the host microbiome — remain largely neglected. Adenoviral types also warrant particular attention especially given the widespread use of adenoviral vector vaccines during the COVID-19 pandemic. Methods Oro-nasal swabs collected from 1679 children under the age of 18 hospitalized in Novosibirsk, Russia between February 2021 and June 2023, were tested for the presence of nucleic acids by the diagnostic panel targeting 17 viruses, 12 bacteria and one yeast. Adenovirus-positive samples were additionally fine-typed by Sanger sequencing. Results Overall, 79.15% of samples were positive for at least one of 17 viral pathogens, with RSV (22.87% positives) and RhV (24.54% positives) dominating the etiological structure. Oro-nasal presence for respiratory pathobionts and opportunistic pathogens was 67.96% and 11.49%, respectively. Generally, viral seasonality was typical for continental climate, with only two notable deviations: MpV absence in spring of 2022 followed by earlier December peaks in the same year; an earlier RSV maximum in October 2021 with extended circulation the next epidemic season. Overall, the epidemiology of the analyzed viruses was consistent with worldwide surveillance trends and largely stable between the two later epidemic seasons. In viral-bacterial association analysis we identified two significantly attracted pairs, in which virus is known to facilitate bacterial adherence to respiratory epithelium. Adenovirus fine-typing provided preliminary evidence that serotypes 1, 2, 3, and 7 are the most frequently detected among the typed samples, while vaccine serotype AdV-5 was identified in only two cases. Conclusion Broad target coverage allowed for a comprehensive analysis of epidemiological patterns, highlighting a trend toward stabilization of the etiological structure to pre-pandemic levels, and allowed for prioritization of clinically relevant viral-bacterial associations. Preliminary findings in adenoviral fine-typing are consistent with global trends in serotype prevalence and help address an important gap in regional adenoviral epidemiology.

source_records.title: Molecular epidemiology of respiratory viral infections in hospitalized children in Novosibirsk, Russia, 2021–2023
source_records.abstract: Acute respiratory infections (ARIs) are among the leading global causes of morbidity and mortality in children. While viral agents of ARI are rigorously monitored, other pathogenic organisms and pathobionts — bacteria and fungi native to the host microbiome — remain largely neglected. Adenoviral types also warrant particular attention especially given the widespread use of adenoviral vector vaccines during the COVID-19 pandemic. Oro-nasal swabs collected from 1679 children under the age of 18 hospitalized in Novosibirsk, Russia between February 2021 and June 2023, were tested for the presence of nucleic acids by the diagnostic panel targeting 17 viruses, 12 bacteria and one yeast. analysis.research_question_and_background: Acute respiratory infections (ARIs) are a major cause of childhood morbidity and mortality globally, yet the role of respiratory pathobionts and opportunistic pathogens alongside viral agents remains understudied.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This study prospectively enrolled 1679 children under 18 years hospitalized in Novosibirsk, Russia between February 2021 and June 2023 to investigate respiratory viral and bacterial etiologies using a comprehensive diagnostic panel.
analysis.methods: Oro-nasal swabs were tested for 17 viruses, 12 bacteria, and one yeast using nucleic acid detection; adenovirus-positive samples underwent Sanger sequencing for fine-typing.
analysis.main_results: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) was detected in 22.87% of samples, making it the second most common viral pathogen after rhinovirus (24.54%), with viral positivity overall at 79.15%.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The observed RSV epidemiology aligned with global surveillance trends and showed stabilization toward pre-pandemic patterns, with preliminary adenoviral serotyping indicating dominance of types 1, 2, 3, and 7.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings support continued RSV surveillance and highlight the need to monitor adenoviral serotype circulation, particularly in the context of adenoviral vector vaccine use.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study’s single-centre design and lack of longitudinal follow-up limit generalizability and causal inference, warranting a moderate confidence assessment.

analysis.summary_en: This prospective hospital-based study in Novosibirsk, Russia, tested 1679 children under 18 years for 17 respiratory viruses, 12 bacteria, and one yeast between February 2021 and June 2023. Using nucleic acid detection and adenoviral fine-typing by Sanger sequencing, the authors found that 79.15% of samples were positive for at least one viral pathogen, with RSV detected in 22.87% of cases, second only to rhinovirus. The epidemiology of RSV mirrored global trends and showed stabilization toward pre-pandemic patterns. Preliminary adenoviral serotyping identified types 1, 2, 3, and 7 as most frequent, while vaccine serotype AdV-5 was rare. The study underscores the importance of comprehensive respiratory pathogen surveillance and supports continued monitoring of adenoviral circulation in the context of vaccine use.

abstract_zh: 背景 急性呼吸道感染 (ARIs) 是全球儿童发病和 死亡率 的主要原因之一。虽然 ARI 的病毒因子受到严格监测,但其他病原生物和病原体(宿主 微生物组原生的细菌和真菌)仍然在很大程度上被忽视。腺病毒类型也值得特别关注,特别是考虑到腺病毒 媒介 疫苗 在 COVID-19 大流行期间的广泛使用。方法 诊断小组对 2021 年 2 月至 2023 年 6 月期间在俄罗斯新西伯利亚住院的 1679 名 18 岁以下儿童采集的口鼻拭子进行了针对 17 种病毒、12 种细菌和 1 种酵母菌的核酸检测。腺病毒阳性样本还通过桑格测序进行精细分型。结果 总体而言,79.15% 的样本对 17 种病毒病原体中的至少一种呈阳性,其中 RSV(22.87% 阳性)和 RhV(24.54% 阳性)在病原学结构中占主导地位。呼吸道病原体和机会性病原体的口鼻存在率分别为 67.96% 和 11.49%。一般来说,病毒季节性是大陆性气候的典型特征,只有两个明显的偏差:2022 年春季没有 MpV,随后同年 12 月初出现峰值;RSV 峰值较早出现在 2021 年 10 月,并在下一个流行季节扩大流通。总体而言,所分析病毒的 流行病学 与全球 监测 趋势一致,并且在随后的两个流行季节之间基本稳定。在病毒-细菌关联分析中,我们发现了两个显着吸引的对,其中病毒已知促进细菌粘附到呼吸道上皮。腺病毒精细分型提供了初步证据,表明血清型1、2、3和7是分型样本中最常检测到的,而疫苗血清型AdV-5仅在两例中被鉴定出。结论 广泛的目标覆盖范围可以对流行病学模式进行全面分析,突出病原学结构稳定至大流行前水平的趋势,并可以优先考虑临床相关的病毒-细菌关联。腺病毒精细分型的初步结果与血清型 患病率 的全球趋势一致,有助于解决区域腺病毒 流行病学 的重要差距。

title: A abordagem clínica da bronquiolite aguda: revisão da literatura
abstract: Acute bronchiolitis is a common respiratory infection in children under two years of age, often caused by the respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), and is one of the main causes of pediatric hospitalization. The objective of this investigation is to describe the main studies for the clinical approach to acute bronchiolitis in current pediatric literature. The methodology of the present study consists of a literature review with a time frame from 2019 to 2024, in the databases of PubMed, SciELO and EBSCO with the descriptors in English: bronchiolitis, virus, children, pediatrics and the use of the Boolean operators “AND” and “OR”. The analysis allows us to state that the diagnosis is purely clinical, based on symptoms such as wheezing, coughing and difficulty breathing, whereas tests are only used in severe cases. Treatment is supportive, with hydration and oxygen therapy, and there is no consensus on the use of medications such as bronchodilators and corticosteroids. Advances include the use of monoclonal antibodies such as Nirsevimab to prevent RSV, and technologies such as lung ultrasound for diagnosis. It is therefore concluded that bronchiolitis requires evidence-based clinical management, prioritizing non-invasive and humanized approaches. Theoretical reviews are important for pediatric practice and the need for multidisciplinary monitoring in the approach to bronchiolitis.

abstract_zh: 急性毛细支气管炎是两岁以下儿童常见的呼吸道感染,常由呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)引起,是儿科住院的主要原因之一。本调查的目的是描述当前儿科文献中针对急性 毛细支气管炎 临床方法的主要研究。本研究的方法包括对 PubMed、SciELO 和 EBSCO 数据库中 2019 年至 2024 年时间范围的文献综述,英文描述符为:毛细支气管炎、病毒、儿童、儿科,以及布尔运算符“AND”和“OR”的使用。通过分析,我们可以说,诊断 纯粹是临床测试,基于喘息、咳嗽和呼吸困难等症状,而测试仅在严重情况下使用。治疗是支持性的,有水合和氧疗,对于支气管扩张剂和皮质类固醇等药物的使用尚未达成共识。进步包括使用 尼塞韦单抗 等单克隆抗体来预防 RSV,以及使用 诊断 等肺部超声技术。因此得出的结论是,毛细支气管炎 需要循证临床管理,优先考虑非侵入性和人性化的方法。理论回顾对于儿科实践非常重要,并且需要在 毛细支气管炎 方法中进行多学科监测。

title: Investigating the Role of microRNA in Host–Influenza A and Other Respiratory RNA Virus Interactions
abstract: Respiratory RNA viruses extensively reprogram host regulatory networks, thereby influencing viral replication, immune evasion, and disease severity. This review examines microRNAs (miRNAs) as regulatory interfaces in host–virus interactions, focusing on influenza A virus as a paradigmatic model while integrating evidence from other respiratory RNA viruses as SARS-CoV-2 and respiratory syncytial virus. After outlining canonical miRNA biogenesis and its manipulation during infection, we discuss how respiratory RNA viruses converge on shared miRNA-regulated pathways, including interferon and NF-κB signaling, apoptosis, autophagy, cellular metabolism, and redox homeostasis. Within these networks, host miRNAs can directly target viral RNAs and modulate antiviral defenses and inflammation, whereas viruses can reshape miRNA expression to facilitate replication, influencing immunopathology. The possibility that RNA viruses encode authentic miRNAs is also critically evaluated; current evidence indicates that manipulating host miRNA biogenesis machinery and remodeling miRNA networks are more prevalent than producing canonical viral miRNAs. Finally, the potential of circulating miRNAs as diagnostic and prognostic biomarkers is considered, as well as the capability of miRNA mimics and antagomiRs to function as host-directed therapeutic strategies. Their clinical translation, however, will require standardized validation, cell- and time-resolved studies, efficient delivery systems, and a careful assessment of specificity, safety, and context-dependent effects.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the role of microRNAs (miRNAs) in host–virus interactions, with a focus on respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) and influenza A virus as key models. It highlights how respiratory RNA viruses, including RSV, reprogram host regulatory networks to influence replication, immune evasion, and disease severity. The review discusses shared miRNA-regulated pathways such as interferon and NF-κB signaling, apoptosis, autophagy, cellular metabolism, and redox homeostasis, emphasizing the dual role of host miRNAs in targeting viral RNAs and modulating antiviral defenses, while viruses manipulate miRNA expression to enhance replication. The review critically evaluates the potential of RNA viruses to encode authentic miRNAs, noting that host miRNA manipulation is more common. It also considers the use of circulating miRNAs as biomarkers and miRNA-based therapeutic strategies, stressing the need for standardized validation, cell- and time-resolved studies, and efficient delivery systems for clinical translation.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 呼吸道 RNA 病毒广泛地重新编程 宿主 调控网络,从而影响病毒复制、免疫逃避和疾病严重程度。本综述研究了 microRNA (miRNA) 作为 宿主 与病毒相互作用中的调节界面,重点关注甲型流感病毒作为范式模型,同时整合了 SARS-CoV-2 和 呼吸道合胞病毒 等其他呼吸道 RNA 病毒的证据。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 在概述了典型的 miRNA 生物发生及其在感染过程中的操作之后,我们讨论了呼吸道 RNA 病毒如何在共享的 miRNA 调节途径上汇聚,包括干扰素和 NF-κB 信号传导、细胞凋亡、自噬、细胞代谢和氧化还原稳态。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 在这些网络中,宿主 miRNA 可以直接靶向病毒 RNA 并调节 抗病毒药物 防御和炎症,而病毒可以重塑 miRNA 表达以促进复制,影响免疫病理学。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: RNA 病毒编码真实 miRNA 的可能性也受到严格评估;目前的证据表明,操纵 宿主 miRNA 生物发生机制和重塑 miRNA 网络比产生典型病毒 miRNA 更为普遍。

title_zh: 研究 microRNA 在 宿主-甲型流感和其他呼吸道 RNA 病毒相互作用中的作用
source_body_en: Respiratory RNA viruses extensively reprogram host regulatory networks, thereby influencing viral replication, immune evasion, and disease severity. This review examines microRNAs (miRNAs) as regulatory interfaces in host–virus interactions, focusing on influenza A virus as a paradigmatic model while integrating evidence from other respiratory RNA viruses as SARS-CoV-2 and respiratory syncytial virus. After outlining canonical miRNA biogenesis and its manipulation during infection, we discuss how respiratory RNA viruses converge on shared miRNA-regulated pathways, including interferon and NF-κB signaling, apoptosis, autophagy, cellular metabolism, and redox homeostasis. Within these networks, host miRNAs can directly target viral RNAs and modulate antiviral defenses and inflammation, whereas viruses can reshape miRNA expression to facilitate replication, influencing immunopathology. The possibility that RNA viruses encode authentic miRNAs is also critically evaluated; current evidence indicates that manipulating host miRNA biogenesis machinery and remodeling miRNA networks are more prevalent than producing canonical viral miRNAs. Finally, the potential of circulating miRNAs as diagnostic and prognostic biomarkers is considered, as well as the capability of miRNA mimics and antagomiRs to function as host-directed therapeutic strategies. Their clinical translation, however, will require standardized validation, cell- and time-resolved studies, efficient delivery systems, and a careful assessment of specificity, safety, and context-dependent effects.
abstract_zh: 呼吸道 RNA 病毒广泛地重新编程 宿主 调控网络,从而影响病毒复制、免疫逃避和疾病严重程度。本综述研究了 microRNA (miRNA) 作为 宿主 与病毒相互作用中的调节界面,重点关注甲型流感病毒作为范式模型,同时整合了 SARS-CoV-2 和 呼吸道合胞病毒 等其他呼吸道 RNA 病毒的证据。在概述了典型的 miRNA 生物发生及其在感染过程中的操作之后,我们讨论了呼吸道 RNA 病毒如何在共享的 miRNA 调节途径上汇聚,包括干扰素和 NF-κB 信号传导、细胞凋亡、自噬、细胞代谢和氧化还原稳态。在这些网络中,宿主 miRNA 可以直接靶向病毒 RNA 并调节 抗病毒药物 防御和炎症,而病毒可以重塑 miRNA 表达以促进复制,影响免疫病理学。RNA 病毒编码真实 miRNA 的可能性也受到严格评估;目前的证据表明,操纵 宿主 miRNA 生物发生机制和重塑 miRNA 网络比产生典型病毒 miRNA 更为普遍。最后,考虑了循环 miRNA 作为诊断和预后生物标志物的潜力,以及 miRNA 模拟物和 antagomiR 作为 宿主 定向治疗策略的能力。然而,它们的临床转化将需要标准化验证、细胞和时间分辨研究、高效的递送系统以及对特异性、安全性和背景依赖性效应的仔细评估。

title: Deciphering the association between Sirt2 modulation and non-canonical Wnt/planar cell polarity-dependent splenic junctional priming: a comparative study of two Sirt2 modulators in murine endotoxemia.
abstract: Enhancement of the splenic function by preserving its cellular/junctional integrity is an underrated effective strategy in combatting infections. The present work aimed to assess the effect of sirtuin (Sirt) modulation in splenic dysfunction associated with lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced endotoxemia in rats. Endotoxemia was induced by a single LPS injection (10 mg/kg; i.p) either solely or preceded by one of 2 Sirt modulators for 3 days; AGK2 (41 mg/kg/d; i.p) or resveratrol (RSV; 40 mg/kg/d; i.p). The results revealed an existing association between AGK2-mediated Sirt-2 inhibition and wingless homolog Wnt5a refining with contemporaneous stimulation of the splenic receptor tyrosine kinase like orphan receptor-2/Frizzled-4/Dishevelled-2 axis. This coincided with enhancement of the planar cell polarity stream (PCP) components, namely, Guanosine-5'-triphosphate-bound Ras homolog family member-A/rho-associated coil-containing protein kinase-1/2, that was in turn linked to augmentation of splenic VE-cadherin content and immunohistochemical expression and instigation of focal adhesion kinase activating phosphorylation. These events were accompanied by enhanced splenic count of differentiated T cells to halt the plasma endotoxin increment with partial suppression of the resultant cytokine storm. The biochemical amendment was further validated by restoration of splenic macro- and microscopic architecture, improved survival and clinical outcomes, and amelioration of end-organ damage markers. Resveratrol failed to achieve such remarkable effects; a conclusion that might be attributed to the hinderance of its anti-inflammatory actions by its Sirt-2 activating capacity, leading to eventual mild endotoxin level decrement in the experimental model. The Sirt2 selective inhibition might be superior in renovating splenic patterning by fine-tuning the Wnt5a/PCP axis and reconstructing junctional scaffolding that functions to expand the blood filtration capacity, besides, immune cells synthesis and migration, presenting a novel approach to conquer the underlying endotoxemia.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addressed the understudied role of splenic cellular and junctional integrity in infection control and sought to evaluate whether sirtuin (Sirt) modulation could mitigate splenic dysfunction during lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced endotoxemia in rats.
analysis.study_design_and_population: An experimental study induced endotoxemia in rats via a single intraperitoneal LPS injection (10 mg/kg), with or without prior administration of two Sirt modulators—AGK2 (41 mg/kg/day) or resveratrol (RSV; 40 mg/kg/day)—for three days.
analysis.methods: Sirt modulators were administered intraperitoneally for three days prior to LPS challenge. Biochemical and histological assessments were performed to evaluate splenic architecture, immune cell differentiation, and signaling pathways, including the Wnt5a/planar cell polarity (PCP) axis and related molecular markers.
analysis.main_results: AGK2-mediated Sirt2 inhibition was associated with activation of the Wnt5a/PCP pathway, increased splenic VE-cadherin content, and immunohistochemical expression, alongside enhanced T-cell differentiation and partial suppression of cytokine storm and endotoxin levels. Resveratrol did not achieve comparable effects.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted Sirt2 inhibition as superior in restoring splenic junctional integrity and immune function by fine-tuning the Wnt5a/PCP axis, presenting a novel therapeutic avenue for endotoxemia management.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that selective Sirt2 inhibition may improve splenic function and clinical outcomes in endotoxemia, potentially informing future strategies for infection control and immune modulation.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its animal model design, lack of randomization, and reliance on a single endotoxemia model, which constrains generalizability to human infections; the evidence strength is assessed as moderate due to these constraints.

analysis.summary_en: This experimental study in rats evaluated the effect of two Sirt modulators, AGK2 and resveratrol, on splenic dysfunction during LPS-induced endotoxemia. AGK2, a Sirt2 inhibitor, was associated with activation of the Wnt5a/planar cell polarity pathway, increased splenic VE-cadherin content, and enhanced T-cell differentiation, alongside partial suppression of cytokine storm and endotoxin levels. Resveratrol, a Sirt2 activator, failed to produce comparable effects. The authors propose that selective Sirt2 inhibition may restore splenic junctional integrity and immune function, offering a novel therapeutic approach for endotoxemia. However, the study’s animal model design, lack of randomization, and reliance on a single endotoxemia model limit generalizability to human infections, warranting cautious interpretation.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究探讨了脾细胞和连接完整性在感染控制中的尚未被研究的作用,并试图评估去乙酰化酶 (Sirt) 的调节是否可以减轻脂多糖 (LPS) 诱导的大鼠内毒素血症期间的脾功能障碍。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 一项实验研究通过单次腹膜内注射 LPS (10 mg/kg) 诱导大鼠内毒素血症,并预先给予或不给予两种 Sirt 调节剂——AGK2(41 mg/kg/天)或白藜芦醇(RSV;40 mg/kg/天)——持续三天。
elements_zh.methods: 在 LPS 攻击前三天腹膜内施用 Sirt 调节剂。进行生化和组织学评估以评估脾结构、免疫细胞分化和信号通路,包括 Wnt5a/平面细胞极性 (PCP) 轴和相关分子标记。
elements_zh.main_results: AGK2 介导的 Sirt2 抑制与 Wnt5a/PCP 通路的激活、脾 VE-钙粘蛋白含量增加和免疫组织化学表达相关,同时增强 T 细胞分化以及部分抑制细胞因子风暴和内毒素水平。白藜芦醇没有达到类似的效果。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者认为 Sirt2 抑制通过微调 Wnt5a/PCP 轴在恢复脾连接完整性和免疫功能方面具有优越性,为内毒素血症管理提供了一种新的治疗途径。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,选择性 Sirt2 抑制可能会改善内毒素血症的脾功能和临床结果,可能为未来的感染控制和免疫调节策略提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到动物模型设计、缺乏随机性以及对单一内毒素血症模型的依赖的限制,这限制了对人类感染的普遍适用性;由于这些限制,证据强度被评估为中等。

title_zh: 解读 Sirt2 调节与非经典 Wnt/平面细胞极性依赖性脾连接启动之间的关联:两种 Sirt2 调节剂在小鼠内毒素血症中的比较研究。
source_body_en: Enhancement of the splenic function by preserving its cellular/junctional integrity is an underrated effective strategy in combatting infections. The present work aimed to assess the effect of sirtuin (Sirt) modulation in splenic dysfunction associated with lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced endotoxemia in rats. Endotoxemia was induced by a single LPS injection (10 mg/kg; i.p) either solely or preceded by one of 2 Sirt modulators for 3 days; AGK2 (41 mg/kg/d; i.p) or resveratrol (RSV; 40 mg/kg/d; i.p). The results revealed an existing association between AGK2-mediated Sirt-2 inhibition and wingless homolog Wnt5a refining with contemporaneous stimulation of the splenic receptor tyrosine kinase like orphan receptor-2/Frizzled-4/Dishevelled-2 axis. This coincided with enhancement of the planar cell polarity stream (PCP) components, namely, Guanosine-5'-triphosphate-bound Ras homolog family member-A/rho-associated coil-containing protein kinase-1/2, that was in turn linked to augmentation of splenic VE-cadherin content and immunohistochemical expression and instigation of focal adhesion kinase activating phosphorylation. These events were accompanied by enhanced splenic count of differentiated T cells to halt the plasma endotoxin increment with partial suppression of the resultant cytokine storm. The biochemical amendment was further validated by restoration of splenic macro- and microscopic architecture, improved survival and clinical outcomes, and amelioration of end-organ damage markers. Resveratrol failed to achieve such remarkable effects; a conclusion that might be attributed to the hinderance of its anti-inflammatory actions by its Sirt-2 activating capacity, leading to eventual mild endotoxin level decrement in the experimental model. The Sirt2 selective inhibition might be superior in renovating splenic patterning by fine-tuning the Wnt5a/PCP axis and reconstructing junctional scaffolding that functions to expand the blood filtration capacity, besides, immune cells synthesis and migration, presenting a novel approach to conquer the underlying endotoxemia.
abstract_zh: 通过保持细胞/连接完整性来增强脾功能是对抗感染的一种被低估的有效策略。目前的工作旨在评估沉默调节蛋白(Sirt)调节对与脂多糖(LPS)诱导的内毒素血症相关的大鼠脾功能障碍的影响。内毒素血症是通过单次 LPS 注射(10 mg/kg;腹腔注射)诱导的,可以单独注射,也可以先注射 2 种 Sirt 调节剂中的一种,注射 3 天;AGK2(41 mg/kg/d;腹腔注射)或白藜芦醇(RSV;40 mg/kg/d;腹腔注射)。结果揭示了 AGK2 介导的 Sirt-2 抑制和无翼同源物 Wnt5a 精炼与同时刺激脾受体酪氨酸激酶(如孤受体 2/Frizzled-4/Dishevelled-2 轴)之间存在关联。这与平面细胞极性流(PCP)成分的增强相一致,即鸟苷-5'-三磷酸结合的Ras同源物家族成员-A/rho相关线圈的蛋白激酶-1/2,这反过来又与脾VE-钙粘蛋白含量和免疫组织化学表达的增加以及粘着斑激酶激活磷酸化的刺激有关。这些事件伴随着脾脏分化 T 细胞计数的增加,以阻止血浆内毒素的增加,并部分抑制由此产生的细胞因子风暴。通过恢复脾脏宏观和微观结构、改善生存和临床结果以及改善终末器官损伤标志物,进一步验证了生化修正。白藜芦醇未能达到如此显着的效果;这一结论可能归因于其 Sirt-2 激活能力阻碍了其抗炎作用,最终导致实验模型中内毒素水平轻度下降。Sirt2选择性抑制可能在通过微调Wnt5a/PCP轴和重建具有扩大血液过滤能力的连接支架来更新脾脏模式方面具有优势,此外,免疫细胞的合成和迁移也提供了一种克服潜在内毒素血症的新方法。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究探讨了脾细胞和连接完整性在感染控制中的尚未被研究的作用,并试图评估去乙酰化酶 (Sirt) 的调节是否可以减轻脂多糖 (LPS) 诱导的大鼠内毒素血症期间的脾功能障碍。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 一项实验研究通过单次腹膜内注射 LPS (10 mg/kg) 诱导大鼠内毒素血症,并预先给予或不给予两种 Sirt 调节剂——AGK2(41 mg/kg/天)或白藜芦醇(RSV;40 mg/kg/天)——持续三天。
analysis_zh.methods: 在 LPS 攻击前三天腹膜内施用 Sirt 调节剂。进行生化和组织学评估以评估脾结构、免疫细胞分化和信号通路,包括 Wnt5a/平面细胞极性 (PCP) 轴和相关分子标记。
analysis_zh.main_results: AGK2 介导的 Sirt2 抑制与 Wnt5a/PCP 通路的激活、脾 VE-钙粘蛋白含量增加和免疫组织化学表达相关,同时增强 T 细胞分化以及部分抑制细胞因子风暴和内毒素水平。白藜芦醇没有达到类似的效果。

analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,选择性 Sirt2 抑制可能会改善内毒素血症的脾功能和临床结果,可能为未来的感染控制和免疫调节策略提供信息。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到动物模型设计、缺乏随机性以及对单一内毒素血症模型的依赖的限制,这限制了对人类感染的普遍适用性;由于这些限制,证据强度被评估为中等。

title: PEDIATRIC PSEUDOTUMOR CEREBRI SYNDROME IN A PREPUBERTAL NON-OBESE BOY: SILENT VISUAL IMPAIRMENT AND A NORMAL BRAIN MRI - A CASE REPORT
abstract: Background: Pseudotumor cerebri syndrome (PTCS) is characterized by elevated intracranial pressure in the setting of normal cerebrospinal fluid composition and normal or typically altered neuroimaging, once secondary causes have been excluded. In adults the disease classically affects young obese women, but in children the demographic profile is more heterogeneous, with prepubertal patients frequently being non-obese and of either sex. Early recognition is essential because untreated PTCS can cause irreversible visual loss, yet the condition is easily overlooked when the clinical presentation deviates from the adult stereotype. Case presentation: A 6-year-10-month-old prepubertal boy with a history of recurrent upper respiratory tract infections presented with a three-week history of abdominal pain, headache, vomiting, and double vision. Body mass index was 13.67 kg/m2 (non-obese). Fundoscopy disclosed bilateral optic disc edema, and visual acuity was mildly reduced to 0.7 in the right eye and 0.5 in the left eye, although the child did not report visual symptoms. Magnetic resonance imaging of the brain, orbits, and whole spine was unremarkable, and computed tomography findings of low-lying cerebellar tonsils were not confirmed on MRI. Diagnostic lumbar puncture yielded clear, colorless cerebrospinal fluid with normal biochemistry and negative infectious and autoimmune workup. Acetazolamide, intravenous mannitol, and therapeutic lumbar puncture were followed by complete visual recovery (1.0 in each eye) and regression of papilledema within two weeks. Respiratory syncytial virus was treated with supportive care and amoxicillin-clavulanate because of suspected bacterial superinfection. Discussion: This case illustrates three teaching points: PTCS must be considered in prepubertal non-obese children regardless of sex; visual impairment may develop silently and recover fully with prompt treatment; and a normal brain MRI does not exclude the diagnosis, which rests on the combination of clinical features, papilledema, cerebrospinal fluid findings, and exclusion of mimics. Conclusion: Clinicians should maintain a low threshold for fundoscopy and lumbar puncture in any child with suggestive symptoms, irrespective of demographic profile, because timely treatment can prevent permanent visual loss even when the child does not report visual symptoms.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Pseudotumor cerebri syndrome (PTCS) is a neurological condition with elevated intracranial pressure and normal cerebrospinal fluid composition, yet its recognition in prepubertal non-obese children is challenging because clinical presentations often deviate from the adult stereotype of obese young women. The study highlights the need for early diagnosis to prevent irreversible visual loss, particularly when symptoms are subtle or atypical.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This is a single-patient case report of a 6-year-10-month-old prepubertal non-obese boy presenting with headache, vomiting, abdominal pain, and double vision. The patient had a history of recurrent upper respiratory tract infections and was managed in a clinical setting where diagnostic lumbar puncture and neuroimaging were performed.
analysis.methods: Diagnostic evaluation included fundoscopy to assess optic disc edema, magnetic resonance imaging of the brain and orbits, computed tomography of the brain, lumbar puncture for cerebrospinal fluid analysis, and exclusion of infectious and autoimmune causes. Treatment involved acetazolamide, intravenous mannitol, and therapeutic lumbar puncture.
analysis.main_results: Fundoscopy revealed bilateral optic disc edema with mildly reduced visual acuity (0.7 right eye, 0.5 left eye). Magnetic resonance imaging of the brain and orbits was unremarkable, and cerebrospinal fluid analysis showed normal biochemistry with no evidence of infection or autoimmunity. Following treatment, visual acuity recovered fully to 1.0 in both eyes, and papilledema regressed within two weeks.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The case demonstrates that PTCS can occur in prepubertal non-obese children regardless of sex, that visual impairment may develop silently, and that a normal brain MRI does not exclude the diagnosis. The novelty lies in emphasizing the importance of prompt recognition and treatment to prevent permanent visual loss even when symptoms are not overtly visual.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings underscore the need for clinicians to maintain a low threshold for fundoscopy and lumbar puncture in children with suggestive symptoms, irrespective of demographic profile, to avoid delayed diagnosis and irreversible complications such as visual loss.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: As a single-case report, the evidence is limited in generalizability and cannot establish causality or prevalence. The strength of the evidence is low due to the lack of comparative data, controls, or broader population sampling.

analysis.summary_en: This case report describes a 6-year-10-month-old prepubertal non-obese boy who presented with headache, vomiting, abdominal pain, and double vision. Diagnostic evaluation revealed bilateral optic disc edema with mildly reduced visual acuity, while neuroimaging and cerebrospinal fluid analysis were unremarkable except for normal intracranial pressure. Treatment with acetazolamide, intravenous mannitol, and therapeutic lumbar puncture led to full visual recovery and regression of papilledema within two weeks. The case highlights that pseudotumor cerebri syndrome can occur in prepubertal non-obese children, that visual impairment may be silent, and that a normal brain MRI does not exclude the diagnosis. Clinicians are advised to maintain a low threshold for fundoscopy and lumbar puncture in children with suggestive symptoms to prevent irreversible visual loss, though the evidence is limited by the single-case design and lack of generalizability.

title_zh: 青春期前非肥胖男孩的小儿假性脑瘤综合征:无症状视力障碍和正常脑部 MRI - 病例报告
source_body_en: Background: Pseudotumor cerebri syndrome (PTCS) is characterized by elevated intracranial pressure in the setting of normal cerebrospinal fluid composition and normal or typically altered neuroimaging, once secondary causes have been excluded. In adults the disease classically affects young obese women, but in children the demographic profile is more heterogeneous, with prepubertal patients frequently being non-obese and of either sex. Early recognition is essential because untreated PTCS can cause irreversible visual loss, yet the condition is easily overlooked when the clinical presentation deviates from the adult stereotype. Case presentation: A 6-year-10-month-old prepubertal boy with a history of recurrent upper respiratory tract infections presented with a three-week history of abdominal pain, headache, vomiting, and double vision. Body mass index was 13.67 kg/m2 (non-obese). Fundoscopy disclosed bilateral optic disc edema, and visual acuity was mildly reduced to 0.7 in the right eye and 0.5 in the left eye, although the child did not report visual symptoms. Magnetic resonance imaging of the brain, orbits, and whole spine was unremarkable, and computed tomography findings of low-lying cerebellar tonsils were not confirmed on MRI. Diagnostic lumbar puncture yielded clear, colorless cerebrospinal fluid with normal biochemistry and negative infectious and autoimmune workup. Acetazolamide, intravenous mannitol, and therapeutic lumbar puncture were followed by complete visual recovery (1.0 in each eye) and regression of papilledema within two weeks. Respiratory syncytial virus was treated with supportive care and amoxicillin-clavulanate because of suspected bacterial superinfection. Discussion: This case illustrates three teaching points: PTCS must be considered in prepubertal non-obese children regardless of sex; visual impairment may develop silently and recover fully with prompt treatment; and a normal brain MRI does not exclude the diagnosis, which rests on the combination of clinical features, papilledema, cerebrospinal fluid findings, and exclusion of mimics. Conclusion: Clinicians should maintain a low threshold for fundoscopy and lumbar puncture in any child with suggestive symptoms, irrespective of demographic profile, because timely treatment can prevent permanent visual loss even when the child does not report visual symptoms.
abstract_zh: 背景:假性脑瘤综合征(PTCS)的特点是在脑脊液成分正常和神经影像学正常或典型改变的情况下,一旦排除次要原因,颅内压就会升高。在成人中,这种疾病通常影响年轻的肥胖女性,但在儿童中,人口统计学特征更加异质,青春期前的患者通常不肥胖且性别不一。早期识别至关重要,因为未经治疗的 PTCS 可能会导致不可逆的视力丧失,但当临床表现偏离成人刻板印象时,这种情况很容易被忽视。病例介绍:一名6岁10个月的青春期前男孩,有反复上呼吸道感染史,有三周腹痛、头痛、呕吐和复视病史。体重指数为 13.67 kg/m2(非肥胖)。眼底镜检查发现双侧视盘水肿,右眼视力轻度下降至0.7,左眼视力轻度下降至0.5,但孩子没有报告视力症状。大脑、眼眶和整个脊柱的磁共振成像没有异常,低位小脑扁桃体的计算机断层扫描结果也没有得到 MRI 的证实。诊断性腰椎穿刺产生透明、无色的脑脊液,生化正常,感染和自身免疫检查结果呈阴性。乙酰唑胺、静脉注射甘露醇和腰椎穿刺治疗后,视力完全恢复(每只眼 1.0),两周内视乳头水肿消退。由于疑似细菌重复感染,呼吸道合胞病毒 接受了支持治疗和阿莫西林克拉维酸治疗。讨论:该案例说明了三个教学要点:无论性别,青春期前非肥胖儿童都必须考虑PTCS;视力障碍可能会悄无声息地发展,并通过提示 治疗 完全恢复;正常的脑 MRI 并不排除 诊断,它依赖于临床特征、视乳头水肿、脑脊液检查结果和排除模仿的结合。结论:对于任何有提示性症状的儿童,无论其人口特征如何,临床医生都应保持较低的眼底镜检查和腰椎穿刺阈值,因为即使儿童没有报告视力症状,及时的 治疗 也可以防止永久性视力丧失。

title: Clinical and epidemiological profiles of six respiratory pathogens in hospitalized children in Lixin County, Anhui, China (2024–2025)
abstract: Background Acute respiratory infections are caused by a diverse range of pathogens. This study aimed to investigate the epidemiological profiles and clinical features of major respiratory pathogens by analyzing their detection rates in hospitalized pediatric patients. Methods Nasopharyngeal swab specimens were retrospectively enrolled from pediatric inpatients diagnosed with acute respiratory infections at the Department of Pediatrics, Lixin County People's Hospital, between February 2024 and August 2025. All specimens were subjected to polymerase chain reaction (PCR) assays targeting six major respiratory pathogens, namely adenovirus, respiratory syncytial virus, influenza A virus, influenza B virus, parainfluenza virus, and Mycoplasma pneumoniae . Based on the PCR results, we further delineated the epidemiological trends, age-stratified distribution, and corresponding clinical profiles associated with each identified pathogen. Results The epidemiological and clinical profiles of the six detected respiratory pathogens are summarized below. In brief, the overall positivity rate of pathogens exhibited winter-spring predominance, with adenovirus and RSV showing the broadest outbreak windows (November–July and November–May, respectively), while influenza A was more restricted (December–March). Mycoplasma pneumoniae displayed a sporadic annual pattern without a statistically significant seasonal peak. Age distribution varied substantially: RSV targeted children 1 year, and influenza A showed a slight infant-toddler predominance. Clinically, while fever and cough were universal, RSV was distinguished by a significantly elevated wheezing rate (27.57% vs. 3.97%–9.52% for others), Febrile seizures were most frequently observed in influenza A virus infections (6.29%), followed by adenovirus (3.57%). Dyspnea or cyanosis was uniformly rare across all pathogens (≤ 0.45%). Conclusion During the winter season, multiple respiratory pathogens tend to circulate actively. Acute respiratory infections caused by different pathogens exhibit distinct age distributions and clinical manifestations. These features, when combined with local epidemiological data, may assist clinicians in promptly identifying the likely causative pathogen.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 急性呼吸道感染是由多种病原体引起的。本研究旨在通过分析住院儿科患者中主要呼吸道病原体的检出率,探讨主要呼吸道病原体的流行病学特征和临床特征。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 回顾性收集2024年2月至2025年8月利辛县人民医院儿科确诊为急性呼吸道感染的儿科住院患者的鼻咽拭子标本。
elements_zh.methods: 所有样本均进行了针对六种主要呼吸道病原体(即腺病毒、呼吸道合胞病毒、甲型流感病毒、乙型流感病毒、副流感病毒和肺炎支原体)的聚合酶链反应(PCR)检测。根据PCR结果,我们进一步描述了与每种已识别病原体相关的流行病学趋势、年龄分层分布以及相应的临床特征。
elements_zh.main_results: 六种检测到的呼吸道病原体的流行病学和临床概况总结如下。简而言之,病原体的总体阳性率表现出冬春优势,其中腺病毒和RSV显示出最宽的暴发窗口(分别为11月至7月和11月至5月),而甲型流感则更为有限(12月至3月)。肺炎支原体表现出零星的年度模式,没有统计上显着的季节性峰值。年龄分布差异很大:RSV 针对 1 岁儿童,而 A 型流感则以婴幼儿为主。临床上,虽然发烧和咳嗽很普遍,但 RSV 的特点是喘息率显着升高(27.57% 对比其他人的 3.97%–9.52%)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 不同病原体引起的急性呼吸道感染具有不同的年龄分布和临床表现。这些特征与当地流行病学数据相结合,可以帮助临床医生及时识别可能的致病病原体。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以帮助临床医生及时识别可能的致病病原体。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据并未报告局限性。
